source_review_checks: Public real export requires passing both-model audit with exact original campaign identity; both complete captures and analyses are checked and their bytes linked back to audit/test/reconstruction seals.

Prediction NPZ is preflighted before output creation: exact permitted keys, all four arms/factors and their order, all4992 row identities/order, exact shapes, finite float64 margins, binary integer predictions and boolean strict flags. Exact original NPZ bytes are copied.

Projected states use exact formal field closure and scalar bits/None; row identities are nonempty scalar strings and optional original hashes are64hex strings. Prompts, token arrays and hidden vectors are omitted.

Projected rows retain full formal states, gold, format/condition/context plus scalar output summaries and candidate IDs needed by unchanged score_arrays and output_token_detail. Production validators check formal labels, full A/B factorial inventory and factor decision/external-fold consistency.

All prescribed production metric scopes replay, including arm/class/quartet/nuisance metrics and percontext values, pooled/easy/hard factors, pairedformat, conditional/strict output, Llama primary/Qwen secondary, Mixed-Offset and fixed context bootstrap.

Three scientific metric modules are copied as exact original sealed bytes and imported under an isolated package. Independent standalone test copied the bundle, made native fixture inputs unavailable, removed repository/PYTHONPATH access and trapped latent_probes/torch/transformers imports.

Public fixture export/replay and promotion by simple flag mismatch are refused; private software fixtures retain conspicuous synthetic status. Static/rehashed tamper, stale/wrong audit and existing-output refusals are covered by code/test inspection. Failed partial bundles preserve failed status and original input bytes are rechecked after export.

remaining_limits: This implementation reuses production metric functions; it is portable replay, not a second independent numeric audit or a hidden-feature-to-prediction reconstruction.
Original capture/audit hashes and export implementation bind the projection; omitted prompts/vectors cannot be independently reconstructed from this compact bundle.
Local hashes provide integrity relative to a retained manifest, not a digital signature. Record/publish the exported manifest hash separately when distributing.
This review covers the named source bytes and synthetic tests. Actual completed campaign export/replay remains subject to root outcome unlock and its own execution receipt.
